pages.text: SYN Finance Weekly analyst note on Kilele Logistics (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 58.95 for KIL3. The note cites steady demand in the logistics sector and cost control at Kilele Logistics (SYN). Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Industry groups welcomed the clarity but asked for more investor education.
